meta_title: Keel – Local PHP, Node.js & database dev stack without Docker
meta_description: Keel installs and runs PHP, Node.js, Caddy, Nginx, Apache, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis and more on macOS, Windows and Linux. Native, isolated, free. No Docker.
og_title: Keel – Your local dev stack, without Docker
og_description: PHP, Node.js, Caddy, Nginx, Apache, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redis and more, installed natively in a click. Free for macOS, Windows and Linux.
ld_description: Local web development stack without Docker: PHP, Node.js, Caddy, Nginx, Apache, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, local HTTPS, tunnels and dev mail.
h1: Your local dev stack, without Docker.
lead: PHP, Node.js, Caddy, Nginx, Apache, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redis and dozens more, installed natively in a click. Sites with HTTPS, tunnels and dev mail in the same app. Remove Keel and your system is exactly as it was.
version_line: Free for macOS, Windows and Linux. Latest version 1.0.2, with signed automatic updates.
features_lead: Everything a local web stack needs, without containers to babysit.
f1_p: Keel downloads real binaries and runs them directly. No Docker Desktop, no VM, no waiting for images, no fans spinning up when you open a project.
f2_p: Choose an initial stack, Web & Full Stack, Modern JS & API or Minimal / Custom, and Keel installs and configures it in one go.
f3_p: Packages, configs and data live in Keel's own folder, apart from Homebrew and your system PATH. Uninstall Keel and nothing is left behind.
f4_p: Create a site and get a virtual host, a local certificate from Keel's own CA and the hosts entry, all from one form.
f5_p: Run several PHP versions, edit php.ini and extensions visually, switch per site.
f6_p: Add Keel to PATH and use php, node, composer, mysql in any terminal, the same versions your sites use.
f7_p: Expose a site with Cloudflare Tunnel, bore, chisel, frp or rathole, without leaving the app.
f8_p: Mailpit catches what your app sends, so test emails never reach a real inbox.
f9_p: 20 languages, works with VoiceOver and other screen readers, full keyboard navigation, and respects Reduce motion.
stack_lead: Optional packages are downloaded from their official sources and licensed by their authors.
s3_d: MariaDB · MySQL · PostgreSQL · MongoDB · Redis · Memcached
s5_d: Cloudflare Tunnel · bore · chisel · frp · rathole
s6_d: Virtual hosts · local SSL (Keel CA) · hosts file
release_note_default: Free for personal and commercial local development.
after: Then open Keel, choose an initial stack in the setup wizard, and create your first site in Websites. Release notes and older versions: GitHub Releases.
a1: Yes, for personal and commercial local development. Keel is built by one person; if it saves you time, you can tip from the app or the project page.
a2: No. Keel runs native builds of each server and database directly on your machine.
q3: Will it clash with Homebrew or my system PHP?
a3: No. Everything Keel installs lives in its own folder. Your terminal only sees Keel's versions if you choose to add Keel to PATH in Settings.
